_producer_notes: Side-effect-only step: reads config.yaml from path resolvable via CONFIG_FILE (defaults to repo root/config.yaml) and writes enriched subscriptions.keywords[*].{related,rewrite} / subscriptions.llm_queries[*].rewrite fields back to disk. No JSON artifact is emitted to archive/. The 'config' schema check below describes the in-memory YAML structure that the script mutates, NOT an output file. required_keys here document the field shape that must be present after enrichment.
